releaseNotes: Embedded Rajdhani display typography and a charcoal, lime, and orange interface inspired by industrial sci-fi design.
Refined buttons with orange corner accents, hover/pressed feedback, and a stable keyboard-focus outline.
Fixed-height error details keep the layout stable for long messages; scroll, copy the full message, or dismiss it.
Added regression coverage for embedded font loading and very long error messages at the minimum window size.
